You will proactively identify detection gaps, lead the development of new detection logic, and establish rigorous validation frameworks to test and tune detections against emerging TTPs.

  • Deep knowledge:  AI, Coding agents, LLMs, prompt engineering, AI-related attack vectors (e.g., prompt injection, jailbreaking), and Agentic concepts all for use in the red team but also testing Cloudflare  uses.
  • Technical Roots: A strong background in manual penetration testing, exploit development, or cloud security (AWS/GCP/Bare Metal).
  • Operational Mindset: Experience using the MITRE ATT&CK framework to map coverage and identify "blind spots" in defensive telemetry.
  • Communication Skills: The ability to explain a complex "0-day" exploit to a non-technical stakeholder while maintaining the respect of a deep-dive engineering team.
  • Tooling Familiarity: Knowledge of automated breach and attack simulation (BAS) tools, as well as custom-built frameworks for payload delivery and C2 infrastructure.

recommendedProjects.title: Model Serving & Inference Microservice with FastAPI
recommendedProjects.description: Package a machine learning model into a production-ready asynchronous Python REST API using FastAPI, Pydantic data validation, and automated batching.
prerequisites: Basic Python programming and NumPy / Pandas familiarity
recommendedProjects.roleFitExplanation: Core capability for AI/ML Engineers: demonstrates taking trained models out of notebooks and deploying them as robust, production-grade microservices.

milestones.title: Validated Input/Output Schemas with Pydantic
milestones.description: Define strict type validation schemas for model inference requests and responses.
acceptanceCriteria: Pydantic BaseModel with field constraints (ranges, string lengths, regex patterns)
Automated OpenAPI / Swagger interactive documentation generated at /docs
Explicit 422 Unprocessable Entity error payloads returned on malformed feature inputs
milestones.expectedEvidence: Pydantic schemas in app/schemas/inference.py and FastAPI app in app/main.py

milestones.title: Model Loading & Asynchronous Predict Endpoint
milestones.description: Load serialized model artifacts at startup and expose high-throughput prediction endpoints.
acceptanceCriteria: Model loaded into memory once on application lifespan startup (not on every request)
POST /predict endpoint running inference and returning structured predictions with confidence scores
Batch prediction endpoint POST /predict/batch processing arrays of items efficiently
milestones.expectedEvidence: Model loader in app/services/model_service.py and inference route in app/api/routes.py

milestones.title: Docker Containerization for ML Runtime
milestones.description: Containerize the FastAPI model service with pinned Python dependencies and health checks.
acceptanceCriteria: Dockerfile with pinned pip versions via requirements.txt or poetry.lock
Container runs as non-root user with Uvicorn worker configuration
Automated test running pytest over sample inference requests inside container
milestones.expectedEvidence: Dockerfile in root and tests in tests/test_inference.py

learningResources.title: Scikit-Learn Model Persistence Guide

recommendedProjects.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) & Vector Search Service
recommendedProjects.description: Build an end-to-end semantic search and Retrieval-Augmented Generation system using text embeddings, vector similarity indexing, and structured prompt engineering.
prerequisites: Model Serving & Inference Microservice with FastAPI
recommendedProjects.roleFitExplanation: Essential for modern GenAI roles: proves hands-on ability to build retrieval pipelines, integrate embeddings, and prevent hallucination with grounded context.

milestones.title: Document Ingestion, Chunking & Embeddings
milestones.description: Build a document processor that extracts text, splits it into overlapping semantic chunks, and generates embeddings.
acceptanceCriteria: Recursive character or token-aware chunking pipeline with configurable chunk size and overlap
Embedding generator generating normalized dense vectors using an open model or API
milestones.expectedEvidence: Chunking logic in app/ingestion/chunker.py and embeddings client in app/services/embeddings.py

milestones.title: Vector Store & Cosine Similarity Indexing
milestones.description: Store and query dense vectors using pgvector in PostgreSQL or an in-memory vector index.
acceptanceCriteria: Vector table with IVFFlat or HNSW cosine similarity index
Query endpoint retrieving top-k most relevant text chunks based on semantic distance threshold
milestones.expectedEvidence: Vector store adapter in app/db/vector_store.py with SQL similarity queries

milestones.title: Grounded Answer Generation with Citations
milestones.description: Assemble retrieved context chunks into a prompt and return answers with source document citations.
acceptanceCriteria: Prompt template injecting retrieved context and instructing model to cite chunk sources
Structured JSON response including the synthesized answer alongside verified chunk IDs and source titles
Fall-back mechanism when semantic similarity is below minimum confidence threshold
milestones.expectedEvidence: Synthesis pipeline in app/services/rag_synthesizer.py and API route in app/api/rag.py

recommendedProjects.title: Containerized Microservice with CI/CD Pipeline & Health Checks

milestones.title: Multi-Stage Dockerfile & Compose Configuration
milestones.description: Create an optimized multi-stage Docker build separating compile time from minimal production runtime.
acceptanceCriteria: Multi-stage Dockerfile using node:alpine or distroless base image for minimal attack surface
Non-root user (USER node) configured for execution
docker-compose.yml orchestrating the API and a PostgreSQL container with health checks

milestones.description: Write a GitHub Actions pipeline triggering on pull requests and pushes to main.
